Eat_breakfast_with_family.name: Eat_breakfast_with_family
steps: gather bread and food at table
sit with family to share first meal
eat slowly to ensure fullness
listen to morning talk or silence

Drink_water_from_well.name: Drink_water_from_well
steps: walk to well with empty jug
draw fresh water with bucket
fill jug and drink deeply
wipe mouth and rest a moment

Sleep_in_family_bed.name: Sleep_in_family_bed
steps: change into nightshirt
lie down in bed
close eyes and relax body
let sleep come after day's labor

Midday_sit_and_eat_bread_in_field.name: Midday_sit_and_eat_bread_in_field
steps: find shady spot at field edge
sit down and catch breath
eat simple bread to regain energy
scan crops while chewing

Check_tools_and_prepare_for_day.name: Check_tools_and_prepare_for_day
steps: inspect hoe and pitchfork for cracks
sharpen edges with whetstone
dress in workclothes for field
gather tools at door ready to go

Plan_fields_and_crop_work.name: Plan_fields_and_crop_work
steps: survey which fields need attention today
recall what Father Marquart said last night
make mental note of tools and persons needed
set order of work for coming hours

Carry_water_back_to_house.name: Carry_water_back_to_house
steps: fill bucket at well
balance load and head home
avoid slipping on stones or mud
deliver water to kitchen

Walk_field_to_market_with_cart.name: Walk_field_to_market_with_cart
steps: load produce and goods into farm cart
guide cart along dirt path to village
watch for ruts, keep cart steady
arrive at market and unload carefully

Escort_Father_to_church.name: Escort_Father_to_church
steps: walk at father's pace to church
assist Father Marquart over rough ground
make sure he is seated for mass
wait outside or join service as needed

Work_in_fields_tilling_and_planting.name: Work_in_fields_tilling_and_planting
steps: walk furrows scanning for weeds
use hoe and plough to till soil
plant or thin out crops as needed
stop to check growing shoots

Feed_and_water_livestock.name: Feed_and_water_livestock
steps: inspect animals for injury or illness
haul feed and water to troughs
ensure all animals eat and drink
collect eggs or milk if required

Trade_produce_at_market.name: Trade_produce_at_market
steps: set up stall or spot for goods
greet market merchants
exchange produce for coins or goods
track what sold and what remains

Help_neighbor_on_their_farm.name: Help_neighbor_on_their_farm
steps: walk over to neighbor's field
ask what help is needed
work alongside neighbors in field
accept thanks, return home

Observe_skilled_farmer_at_work.name: Observe_skilled_farmer_at_work
steps: watch elder or skilled farmer closely
note techniques with plough or planting
ask questions if appropriate
try to mirror action afterwards

Practice_pitchfork_and_hoe_skills.name: Practice_pitchfork_and_hoe_skills
steps: select patch to work on skill
practice proper grip with tools
test stamina and pace
inspect result, refine movement

Reflect_on_fairness_of_land_division.name: Reflect_on_fairness_of_land_division
steps: sit away from others as day ends
ponder what is just in inheritance
recall promises or words from parents
resolve to speak out if wronged

Muster_courage_for_tough_conversation.name: Muster_courage_for_tough_conversation
steps: take deep breaths to steady nerves
think on what must be said
visualize speaking up with strength
decide to act for fairness

Attend_village_gathering.name: Attend_village_gathering
steps: walk to village square when bell rings
greet neighbors and speak of weather
share laugh or simple gossip
return home ready for next day

Stroll_by_riverbank_to_clear_head.name: Stroll_by_riverbank_to_clear_head
steps: walk slowly along cool riverbank
listen to sound of water and birds
sit on rock, skip stones if wished
let thoughts drift and calm temper

Exchange_words_with_Francoise.name: Exchange_words_with_Francoise
steps: seek Francoise along path or at market
greet her with respectful words
ask about her family or fields
inquire if she will walk awhile

Treat_minor_wounds_after_work.name: Treat_minor_wounds_after_work
steps: inspect hands and arms for scrapes
wash wounds at water basin
wrap cloth around deep cuts
rest hand until pain eases

Wash_face_and_hands.name: Wash_face_and_hands
steps: fetch fresh water in bucket
splash face and wash dirt from hands
dry with coarse towel
feel alert and ready

Stretch_and_loosen_sore_muscles.name: Stretch_and_loosen_sore_muscles
steps: stand and flex tight arms and back
bend, stretch legs before labor
rotate shoulders to ease pain
breathe in fresh morning air

Inspect_farm_tools_for_damage.name: Inspect_farm_tools_for_damage
steps: gather tools after day's work
examine handles for cracks or splits
test sharpness of blades
set aside tool needing repair

Sharpen_blades_on_whetstone.name: Sharpen_blades_on_whetstone
steps: collect all dull tools
grind edge carefully on whetstone
wipe blade and check for burrs
re-stack tools for next day

Repair_farm_cart_wheel_if_needed.name: Repair_farm_cart_wheel_if_needed
steps: inspect cart wheel for wobble or cracks
remove damaged wheel from axle
tighten spokes or patch rim
test cart with short roll

Check_field_for_signs_of_crop_failure.name: Check_field_for_signs_of_crop_failure
steps: walk furrows scanning for withered plants
check for insects or rot
note patches with poor growth
report findings to family

Avoid_potential_river_accident.name: Avoid_potential_river_accident
steps: approach river cautiously
scan for slippery rocks or fast current
keep distance from hazard spots
complete task and step away safe

Take_break_before_overwork_exhaustion.name: Take_break_before_overwork_exhaustion
steps: notice signs of heavy fatigue
set aside tool and sit at field edge
sip water and breathe slowly
resume work only when strength returns

Negotiate_inheritance_with_father.name: Negotiate_inheritance_with_father
steps: find moment alone with Father Marquart
state wish and right to fair share of land
listen to response and argue if needed
try to reach understanding or next step

Confer_with_Father_about_land.name: Confer_with_Father_about_land
steps: ask Father Marquart for his thought on fields
note his intention for division
ask questions, clarify disputes
thank him and resolve to act on knowledge

Present_small_gift_to_Francoise.name: Present_small_gift_to_Francoise
steps: prepare or choose simple present
find moment privately with Francoise
offer gift with plain words
watch her reaction and hope for favor
